filing-ad26-7-pjm-governance-vote.point: Confidential talks facilitated by FERC's Dispute Resolution Service began September 1.
filing-ad26-7-pjm-governance-vote.quote: on September 1st, representatives of PJM, the states in the region, Members, and stakeholders commenced confidential and privileged discussions facilitated by FERC's Dispute Resolution Service.

filing-ad26-7-pjm-governance-vote.point: The Members term sheet won the required two-thirds vote over the PJM and Consumer Advocates term sheets.
filing-ad26-7-pjm-governance-vote.quote: The Members term sheet, sponsored by a group of PJM Members, received the requisite sector-weighted two-thirds majority vote of the PJM Members Committee

filing-ad26-7-pjm-governance-vote.point: PJM reports that the Organization of PJM States and the Governors' Collaborative do not view the approved term sheet as satisfactory.
filing-ad26-7-pjm-governance-vote.quote: the Organization of PJM States, Inc., the PJM Governors' Collaborative and other state representatives do not view the approved term sheet as satisfactory.
